standard-dialogue-without-stew.player: Well, it's not every day you see a man up a tree.

standard-dialogue-without-stew.speaker: Guard
standard-dialogue-without-stew.text: I'm trying to observe a suspect. Leave me alone!
If the player does not know about the Draynor Bank Robbery:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Hadn't you heard? You'd better go and talk to the other guard, the one by the bank door. He'll tell you all about it.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Go on, ask him what's wrong with the bank wall. He loves when people ask him that.

standard-dialogue-without-stew.text: If the player knows about the Draynor Bank Robbery:

options.text: This is about the bank robbery, right?

steps.player: This is about the bank robbery, right?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Yes, that's right. We're keeping the suspect under tight observation for the moment.

steps.player: Can't you just... I dunno... arrest him?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I'm not meant to discuss the case. You know what confidentiality rules are like.

options.text: You're not being very subtle up there.

steps.player: You're not being very subtle up there.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I'd be doing a lot better if nits like you didn't come crowding around me all day!

steps.player: But your legs are hanging down!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Go away!

options.text: Can I do anything to help?

steps.player: Can I do anything to help?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: That's very kind of you. I'd rather like a nice bowl of stew, if you could fetch me one. I don't get many meal breaks.

steps.player: You want a bowl of stew?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: If you wouldn't mind...

standard-dialogue-with-stew.speaker: Guard
standard-dialogue-with-stew.text: Yes, what do you... I say, is that stew for me?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Gosh, that's very kind of you! Here, have a few coins for your trouble...
30 coins
The guard eats the stew
The guard drops the empty bowl out of the tree!

options.text: No, I want to keep this stew!

steps.player: No, I want to keep this stew!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Fair enough. But if you change your mind, I'll probably still be here.

standard-dialogue-using-a-stew-on-the-tr.speaker: Guard
standard-dialogue-using-a-stew-on-the-tr.text: Gosh, that's very kind of you! Here, have a few coins for your trouble...
The guard drops the empty bowl out of the tree!

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.player: I think I should leave him in peace to finish his stew!

standard-dialogue-using-any-other-item-o.speaker: Guard
standard-dialogue-using-any-other-item-o.text: Why the demoninikin are you waving THAT at me?

standard-dialogue-using-any-other-item-o.player: Sorry, I thought you'd like it.

standard-dialogue-using-any-other-item-o.speaker: Guard
standard-dialogue-using-any-other-item-o.text: Erm... No thanks! Now, if you don't mind, I'm trying to observe this suspect!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Ooooch!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Oi!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Watch what you're doing with that axe, you nit!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: You'll blow my cover! I'm meant to be hidden!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Will you stop that?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Don't draw attention to me!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Hey - gerroff me!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Ow! That really hurt!
